sentences.text:
: 
Surya Prakash, Arsh Bugga 
Counsel for Opposite Party(s) 
Manoj Yadav @ Manoj Kumar Yadav vs State Of U.P.Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 6 November, 2025
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned AGA for the State.
Whereas, no one has put in appearance on behalf of the complainant despite notice.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Crime No. 246/2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. & Section 5(??)/6 POCSO Act, Police Station - Kotwali Sadar, District - Lakhimpur Kheri.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that in terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was enticed away by the applicant.
Subsequently, the victim did not support the prosecution's version and stated that both are married.
The tentative age of the victim is around 18 years.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
He has filed counter affidavit which is taken on record.

5. Considering statement of the victim coupled with the fact that the applicant is in custody since 10.02.2024 and has no criminal antecedent, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant- Manoj Yadav @ Manoj Kumar Yadav be released on bail in aforesaid FIR/Case Crime Number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of ? 20,000/-
(Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(Pankaj Bhatia,J.) November 6, 2025 Mohit Singh/-
